scope: Native terminal mechanics with shared daemon-owned lifecycle policy and durable supervised coordination

contracts.behavior: The Update in Place context-menu item always remains visible, is greyed out without a different usable binary and becomes enabled when one is detected, including availability changes while the menu is open
The lifecycle coordinator uses the shared application adapters; tmux reattaches to the exact live server/session without stopping its server or applications before the original window closes

Non-tmux restarts require explicit consent, collected either by the native menu or the launcher without a second modal; the original window stays held until replacement application verification and final commit
Replies and close authorization are bound to the window, PID, operation and unique helper owner
Retargeting, missing helpers, changed tabs, cancellation and failed preparation cannot close the original
Exact placement retains offscreen coordinates only for matching monitor metadata and reports the actual mismatch

Real tmux, confirmed two-tab shell and Codex updates use a private instance of the release lifecycle daemon under software-rendered KWin, preserving offscreen placement, active tab, directories and exact conversations; confirmed work survives daemon termination and its result is recovered after restart. After resumed Codex exits normally, the same replacement window and tab remain alive with idle Fish, including compatibility/no-tab-API updates

The terminal menu and enhanced native clients use one mechanics helper and one shared daemon-owned application policy. Missing or old lifecycle support refuses before application shutdown. For older running terminals without update/hold APIs, the daemon supplies external CLI/KWin mechanics with the same coordinator, optionally using ListTerminals; no tab API requires exactly one window and controlling PTY. There is no duplicate Codex/session detector in the terminal helper

Window-only updates preserve the running native application image, including deleted builds, and retain durable private recovery executables; individual program updates may choose the latest installed image. Allowlisted colour and locale values, including absent overrides, survive startup without persisting arbitrary secrets

environments.automated_gui: Private HOME/XDG, session bus and Xvfb; mock worker and optional launcher-call canary, no real tracker
environments.automated_backend: Temporary files, fake KWin backend and real private child startup sockets
environments.native_wayland: Disposable tmux, shell, monitor and Codex fixtures under private bus/HOME/XDG, real release applicationlauncherd and software KWin. A test-only supervisor detaches jobs independently of the daemon. Set XFCE_LIFECYCLE_DAEMON and optionally XFCE_LIFECYCLE_CODEX_FIXTURE to the separate checkout's artifacts. No real user windows are replaced
